Title: MSI announces custom GeForce RTXTM 2060 GPU series
URL: https://event.msi.com/edm/Newsletter/201901.html
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
MSI announces custom GeForce RTXTM 2060 GPU series

| MSI announces custom GeForce RTX TM 2060 GPU series |
| --- |
| [Taipei, Taiwan] As the world's most popular GAMING graphics card vendor, MSI is proud to introduce the graphics cards based on NVIDIA’s Turing TM architecture with outstanding performance. Equipped with improved thermal design, MSI GeForce RTX TM 2060 series are optimized for higher core and memory clock speeds for increased performance in games. MSI’s GAMING series delivers excellent thermal performance that gamers have yearned for MSI. A solid and sharp appearance, VENTUS provides a sturdy dual fan design with excellent performance. Both products are able to fulfill gamers looking forward to getting amazing experience in game. |

GeForce RTX TM 2060 GAMING Z 6G

 As GeForce RTX TM 2070 GAMING, the 7th generation of the iconic TWIN FROZR series is brought to MSI GeForce RTX TM 2060 GAMING series as well. The improved TWIN FROZR 7 design on the GeForce RTX TM 2060 GAMING utilizes two 9 cm TORX 3.0 fans which combine the advantages of both traditional and dispersion fan blade to generate huge amounts of airflow. The new trims on the traditional fan blades create concentrated airflow for higher air pressure while also reducing noise. The heatsink features specific design for efficient heat dissipation to keep the temperature low and performance high. The new gunmetal grey & black look emphasizes the glorious glow of Mystic Light RGB infused into the card. Using the updated & improved MSI Mystic Light software, controlling and syncing your LED-lit components is easier than ever.

GeForce RTX TM 2060 VENTUS 6G OC

 Dressed in a fashionable Black & Silver design inspired by a solid dual-fan design, the MSI GeForce RTX TM 2060 VENTUS 6G OC is perfect for gamers and case modders looking for something unique and different. The new dual-fan thermal design with MSI’s classic TORX Fan 2.0 providing more concentrated airflow and air pressure for enhanced cooling performance. The heatpipes with direct-contact design transfers more heat from GPU to heat heatsink quickly and efficiently. 

GeForce RTX TM 2060 AERO ITX 6G OC

 Measuring in at max 175mm length, the AERO ITX model is small in size, but just as big in performance as their bigger brothers. Matching perfectly with the new Z390I GAMING EDGE AC motherboard, this makes them ideal for small form factor gaming systems and HTPC’s. The AERO ITX model utilizes a single high-performance fan on a compact heatsink featuring two heatpipes and optimized dissipation. All of this is covered by a very classy looking black and white shroud with some carbon details. Even in a small form factor, staying as silent as possible is important. 

MSI DRAGON CENTER

 MSI Dragon Center is a brand new software platform with the goal to integrate all MSI software for components, desktop systems and peripherals. For MSI GAMING & SEA HAWK graphics cards, the MSI Dragon Center allows gamers to quickly switch between OC and Silent performance modes. The all-new software features Gaming Mode, which instantly optimizes your hardware for the best gaming experience including SSD, monitor and network settings. This budding new software platform will continue to improve and evolve, including more unique functionalities and benefits for MSI gamers.

...

MSI Afterburner is the world's most recognized and widely used graphics card Overclocking software. It gives you full control of your graphics card and enables you to monitor your system’s key metrics in real-time. The latest version of MSI Afterburner features OC Scanner for GeForce RTX TM 20 series graphics cards. OC Scanner is an automated function that will find the highest stable overclock settings for your card. Afterburner gives you a free performance boost for a smooth in-game experience thanks to higher FPS.

AVAILABILITY

The new MSI GeForce RTXTM 2060-based cards are expected to be available starting 15th January, 2019. All models will vary by different area.

Title: 価格.com - MSI、「GeForce RTX 2060」を搭載したビデオカード3機種
URL: https://news.kakaku.com/prdnews/cd=pc/ctcd=0550/id=81033/
Published: 2019-01-10T06:43:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
MSIは、ビデオカードの新製品として、「GeForce RTX 2060 GAMING Z 6G」「GeForce RTX 2060 VENTUS 6G OC」「GeForce RTX 2060 AERO ITX 6G OC」の3機種を発表。1月15日以降順次発売する。

いずれも、NVIDIAのミドルレンジGPU「GeForce RTX 2060」を搭載したモデル。冷却面では、「GeForce RTX 2060 GAMING Z 6G」「GeForce RTX 2060 VENTUS 6G OC」がデュアルファンを、「GeForce RTX 2060 AERO ITX 6G OC」がシングルファンを搭載する。

また、オーバークロック仕様を採用。ブーストクロックの定格が1680MHzに対し、「GeForce RTX 2060 GAMING Z 6G」のブーストクロックが1800MHz、「GeForce RTX 2060 VENTUS 6G OC」「GeForce RTX 2060 AERO ITX 6G OC」のブーストクロックが1710MHzになっている。

共通の仕様は、データレートが14Gbps、メモリーインターフェイス幅が192bit。ビデオメモリーはGDDR6で、容量が6GB。

このほか、PC接続インターフェイスはPCI Express 3.0 x16。ディスプレイインターフェイスは、DisplayPort 1.4×3、HDMI 2.0b×1を装備。補助電源コネクターは8ピン。

「GeForce RTX 2060 GAMING Z 6G」は、2つの9cmトルクスファン 3.0を採用したGPUクーラー「TWIN FROZR 7」を採用したモデル。ライティング機能として「Mystic Light RGB」を搭載する。

「GeForce RTX 2060 VENTUS 6G OC」は、2つのトルクスファン 2.0を搭載したモデル。最大6mm厚の銅ヒートパイプを備えており、高い冷却能力を実現している。

「GeForce RTX 2060 AERO ITX 6G OC」は、長さ175mmというコンパクトサイズを採用したモデル。1つのファンを2本のヒートパイプを搭載したコンパクトなヒートシンクに装着し、効率的な廃熱を実現している。

---
